intro.title: My Journey
intro.desc:
With a background in electrical engineering, I have always seen programming as a powerful tool for solving complex challenges.

After a successful first chapter in the energy sector, I chose to turn my passion for development into my profession. 

My journey has allowed me to master backend architectures before flourishing in full-stack roles, where I now combine a global vision with technical precision.
